title: When the Yearbook Turns
author: Edmund Kavanagh
blurb: Paloma Ishikawa, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
